title: XAUUSD: non-directional macro gate — elevated spread/range in NFP/CPI/FOMC window vs same clock non-event days
power_gate_note: Power Gate V1.4 cannot certify POWER_READY without a preregistered level calibration (NEXUS_POWER_GATE_V1). Until then every run of this hypothesis is EXPLORATORY_ONLY. Never promote to VALIDATED from this experiment alone.
data_access_statement: Written in a cloud container that has no sourced NFP/CPI/FOMC calendar with verified pre-release timestamps and no Phase 7 tick/M15 files for this hypothesis. No spread/range outcome has been computed on any real gold series before this file was committed. The committed CSV under fixtures/ is SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE for CI only.
question: In the window from 5 minutes before to 30 minutes after scheduled NFP, CPI, and FOMC statement releases, are mean bid-ask spread and mid-price range on XAUUSD strictly higher than the same America/New_York local clock on matched non-event weekdays, with stable sign across two discovery windows and without single-year concentration?
phase_note: Phase 1 does not trade direction. It only tests whether microstructure (spread, range) elevates in the event window — the premise for blocking or reducing entries. Directional event trading is out of V1 scope and needs a new hypothesis_id plus consensus/surprise fields.
primary_outcome: joint elevation: at least one of mean_spread_delta or mean_range_delta has month-block CI95 with low > 0 on combined discoveries

comparator.definition: For each event, measure mean_spread and mid_range in [release−pre_minutes, release+post_minutes). Control = mean of the same America/New_York local clock windows on up to max_controls_per_event non-event weekdays with the same weekday, inside the split, outside exclusions, within control_lookback_weeks. Delta = event_metric − mean(control_metric). Falsify (F1) if neither spread_delta nor range_delta has CI low > 0.

param_provenance.pre_minutes: 5 — research 01 candidate #3: block/reduce from 5 minutes before release
param_provenance.post_minutes: 30 — research 01 candidate #3: through 30 minutes after release
param_provenance.event_types: NFP, CPI, FOMC_STATEMENT only in V1; PCE and others out of scope
param_provenance.control_lookback_weeks: 8 weeks a priori for same-weekday matched controls
param_provenance.max_controls_per_event: 4 a priori cap to keep matched sets tight
param_provenance.min_n_per_discovery: 12 events — lower than daily-session studies because macro events are sparse (~3/month combined)
param_provenance.year_concentration_max_share: 0.5 a priori concentration falsifier on mean_spread_delta

calendar_prerequisite.timestamp_rule: Use the public release clock available *before* the print (scheduled/announced time from agency archives). Never invent times. Never use post-hoc revised clocks without documenting the revision.
calendar_prerequisite.consensus_rule: forecast/consensus may be empty for phase-1 microstructure. Directional phase (future hypothesis_id) requires forecast with forecast_source licensed before release.
calendar_prerequisite.how_to_obtain: See server/research_scripts/macro_calendar_v1/SOURCES.md — BLS (CPI/NFP, often 403 from non-browser), Fed FOMC calendars + press releases (14:00 ET verified on sample statements), optional MT5 CalendarValueHistory export on PC. Store as CSV under macro_event_gate_v1/data/ (gitignored) with source_url per row.
calendar_prerequisite.fixture: fixtures/sample_events_synthetic.csv is SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE for CI schema/window tests only; runner refuses it unless --allow-synthetic-calendar.

discovery_b.access: ITERABLE for this hypothesis only; used for sign-stability falsifier vs discovery_a

internal_validation.access: ONE_SHOT after combined_discoveries pass with frozen params; max EXPLORATORY_PROMISING / EXPLORATORY_ONLY

excluded_phase7_sealed_holdout.access: PHYSICALLY_EXCLUDED — Phase 7 sealed holdout; runner refuses

forward_after_seal.access: NOT in V1 runner; future independence window after seal

falsification.F1_spread_and_vol_not_elevated_vs_same_c: On combined discovery_a∪discovery_b, neither mean_spread_delta nor mean_range_delta has month-block bootstrap 95% CI with low > 0 → FAIL
falsification.F2_year_concentration: Among years with n≥8 in combined discoveries, one year share of sum(max(yearly_mean_spread_delta,0)) > year_concentration_max_share → FAIL
falsification.F3_sign_flip_across_discoveries: sign(primary elevated metric) differs between discovery_a and discovery_b when both n≥min_n_per_discovery → FAIL
falsification.insufficient_n: discovery n_closed < min_n_per_discovery or combined n_closed < min_n_combined_for_ci → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

decision_vocabulary.EXPLORATORY_PROMISING: Elevation survives F1–F3; still EXPLORATORY_ONLY / not POWER_READY / not VALIDATED; does not authorize live gate enable alone
decision_vocabulary.VALIDATED: FORBIDDEN for this hypothesis_id — requires separate promotion gate with power + true holdout + parity

exposure_statement.this_hypothesis: No real XAUUSD tick/M15 series and no sourced macro calendar have been read for outcome computation under this hypothesis_id.
exposure_statement.neighbouring_studies: Phase 7 / session-drift / trend-gate traversed overlapping calendars for other estimands. Macro-gate microstructure is a different estimand, but discovery/IV windows are not a virgin TRUE_HOLDOUT.
exposure_statement.consequence: Maximum after internal_validation: EXPLORATORY_PROMISING under evidence_ceiling EXPLORATORY_ONLY.
exposure_statement.rule: Parameters may change only under a new hypothesis_id. Runner refuses a run whose params hash differs from an earlier run of the same hypothesis_id.

anti_scope: No re-enable of FAILED or DEFECT_BLOCKED strategies
No MQL5 live signal wiring in V1
No directional surprise trading in V1
No invented backtest results or invented release timestamps
Do not continue SD-TOKYO-LONDON-001 or TG-12M-GATE-001 (both FAIL)
known_limits: Sparse events → smaller n than session-drift; month-block CI may be wide
M15 mid-range is a coarse vol proxy; tick-level realized vol is a future refinement under a new hypothesis_id
Broker spreads differ from Dukascopy research ticks
Power Gate V1.4: EXPLORATORY_ONLY / NOT_ASSESSABLE until level calibration exists
Consensus/forecast often unavailable without paid license — not required for phase 1

required_data: Sourced calendar CSV (NFP+CPI+FOMC_STATEMENT) with release_date_local + release_time_local + source_url
M15 bid/ask bars (or tick→M15) covering discovery windows; Phase 7 Dukascopy path on PC
pc_execution.tester_note: MT5 Tester parity is optional later and not required to falsify V1 on research M15
